incidents.title: IRGC-affiliated CyberAv3ngers uses ChatGPT to research PLC vulnerabilities
incidents.targets: Industrial control systems and PLCs (water, manufacturing, energy); Israel, US, Ireland
incidents.outcome: OpenAI banned the accounts and says the models gave limited incremental capability.
incidents.confidenceReason: OpenAI, the model provider, states the accounts used its models for this work.
incidents.summary: Accounts tied to CyberAv3ngers, an IRGC-affiliated group known for attacks on industrial control systems, used ChatGPT to research PLC vulnerabilities and default credentials, debug code and ask for scripting help. The date is the report month.
incidents.quote: Accounts operated by this threat actor used our models to research vulnerabilities, debug code, and ask for scripting advice.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only OpenAI has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Hong Kong fraudsters use deepfake tech to swindle love-struck men out of HK$360 million
incidents.outcome: Victims across Asia lost about HK$360 million.
incidents.confidenceReason: In the archived SCMP text, the deepfake detail is the outlet's own narration plus "Sources said it was the first time ... employed deepfake artificial intelligence (AI) technology". No named police statement on the AI use is visible, so the grade is Suspected.
incidents.summary: A Hong Kong-based syndicate used deepfake AI to pose as women in video calls and lure men across Asia into fake crypto investments.
incidents.quote: Sources said it was the first time local authorities had cracked down on a Hong Kong-based fraud syndicate that employed deepfake artificial intelligence (AI) technology to cheat people.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only South China Morning Post has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Wiz employees get deepfake voice messages from CEO
incidents.outcome: Blocked; employees noticed it did not sound like the CEO. Credentials were the goal.
incidents.confidenceReason: The CEO's first-hand account is quoted on the record by TechCrunch ("Dozens of my employees got a voice message from me"). It has specifics but shows no evidence, so the grade is Strong.
incidents.summary: Attackers cloned the CEO's voice from a conference recording and sent voice messages to dozens of employees to harvest credentials. The conference voice differed from his everyday voice, which tipped staff off.
incidents.quote: Dozens of my employees got a voice message from me
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only TechCrunch has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: Deepfake/impersonation tool only, no agent harness
